d: Union Home Minister Amit Shah formally inaugurated the permanent campus of the 12th Battalion of the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) near Itanagar in Arunachal Pradesh, addressing an audience including Chief Minister Pema Khandu and Union Minister Kiren Rijiju. Amit Shah underlined that the facility, built according to earthquake-resistant standards, will strengthen disaster preparedness and serve as a training base for State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) personnel across all eight northeastern states.
